acceptance_criteria.criterion: The §8.2 pseudocode includes AND NOT p.auto_cancelled in the prerequisite pipeline filter.
A note explains that auto-cancelled pipelines are excluded to prevent erroneously cancelled pipelines from blocking downstream stages, consistent with §21.27.
No other sections of the spec are altered.

summary: Updated §8.2 prerequisite check pseudocode in pipeline-routing.md to add `AND NOT p.auto_cancelled` to the prerequisite pipeline filter, and added an explanatory note stating that auto-cancelled pipelines are excluded from the prerequisite lookup consistent with §21.27.

comments.note: §21.27 in edge-cases.md still contains the bullet 'Auto-cancelled pipelines are NOT excluded from prerequisite checks — an auto-cancelled prerequisite still blocks the next stage', which now directly contradicts the updated §8.2. A follow-up task should remove or revise that bullet to reflect the new behavior. Leaving it as-is will confuse readers of edge-cases.md.

No other sections of the spec were altered, per AC. The §8.2 note references §21.27 as the general auto_cancelled exclusion authority, which is accurate for the overall pattern even though §21.27's prerequisite-specific bullet is now stale.
